x_max.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the right

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

x_min.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the left

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

y_max.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the bottom

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

y_min.docs:
**int**: The raw value corresponding to the top

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

calibration.docs:
The XPT2046 is a resistive touch screen and it will require calibration on a per-device basis.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The chip select pin. Often marked `T_CS` on the board.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this sensor.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The touch detection pin. Often marked `T_IRQ` on the board. If not specified the component will use polling via SPI. This key is renamed from **irq_pin**

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

threshold.docs:
**int**: The value to detect the touch or release. Defaults to `400`.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. If `interrupt_pin` is specified the touch will be detected nearly instantaneously and this setting will be used only for the release detection. Defaults to `50ms`.

*See also: [XPT2046 Touch Screen Controller (Updated version)](https://esphome.io/components/touchscreen/xpt2046#configuration-variables)*
